recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #313
recent_posts.summary: Issue #313 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers Jetpack Compose topics including a rethinking of multi-backstack navigation for bottom tabs with Nav3, accessible focus indicators via a custom modifier, the Haze 2.0 visual effects library update, document editing in Compose, and hot reload for animation iteration. The resource roundup highlights a hotkey DSL (HyperKey), a Harfbuzz Compose Multiplatform port for Arabic text rendering, a mixed-content vertical scroll container, and several community libraries for carousels, syntax highlighting, toasts, PDF rendering, splash screens, tile maps, and PWA generation. A section on AI coding agent skills for Compose is also included.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #312
recent_posts.summary: Jetpack Compose 1.11.0 is now stable, with the release train moving to 1.12.0-alpha01. Key highlights include new test utilities (runWhenIdle, awaitAndRunWhenIdle), shape morphing overloads in Material3, and updates across many Compose-related artifacts. Compose Multiplatform 1.11.0-beta03 is out with drag-to-scroll in SelectionContainer. The newsletter also covers the new LinkBuffer slot table approach introduced experimentally in Compose 1.10 and its performance implications, multiplatform composable testing improvements, adaptive layouts with Nav3, and DrawScope usage. Community resources include a KMP table renderer, a multiplatform PDF renderer, a richer text underline library, and dynamic localization support.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #311
recent_posts.summary: Issue #311 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers Jetpack Compose topics including ViewModel scoping changes in Navigation 3 (where all destinations share a single ViewModel by default), Compose Preview-driven development, stability optimization, and differences between Preview rendering and real device rendering. Also featured: inclusive drag-and-drop with accessibility improvements, shared element transitions in Nav3 using LocalNavAnimatedContentScope, Google's official Android coding agent skills, an MCP server wrapping those skills, a CLI for browsing @Preview functions, and a Compose Multiplatform emoji picker. A curated list of open source libraries and articles rounds out the issue.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #310
recent_posts.summary: Issue #310 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers the latest Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform release train updates, including Compose Multiplatform 1.11.0-beta02, Compose for Android 1.11.0-rc01, and various alpha/beta releases for Material3, TV Compose, Wear Compose, Nav3, and more. Featured articles cover runtime app language switching in Compose, debugging an IrLinkageError in Kotlin Multiplatform, and atomic design implementation on Android. New open-source libraries highlighted include a contextual app bar, a color picker DSL, a thermal printer KMP library, and a new Jetpack Compose API reference site. Maps for Compose reaches v8.3.0 with WMS tile overlay support.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #309
recent_posts.summary: Issue #309 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform news. Highlights include Media3 1.10.0 stable release with Compose UI modules, enforcing design system rules with custom Detekt rules, cross-platform haptics using Compose Multiplatform, biometric authentication via the new biometric-compose library, and a @RequireOptIn-based @PreviewOnly annotation pattern. Resource roundups feature several open-source projects: a CodeMirror 6 port for Compose Multiplatform, a JSON editor/viewer, a Notion-style block editor, an LLM-powered Material3 theme generator using Gemini Nano, and a tile-based image loader for large images. Also included are AI coding agent skill rosters for Compose development.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #307
recent_posts.summary: Issue #307 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers Compose Multiplatform 1.10.3 patch release, Jetpack Media3 updates, and a range of community articles. Highlights include six approaches to drawing glowing borders in Jetpack Compose, a 34% startup performance improvement using StrictMode, and an exploration of the RememberObserver API. New open-source resources include Compose Hot Swan (hot reload for Android devices), a Material3 side sheet for Compose Multiplatform, a pinch-to-resize grid, and a Storybook-style component catalog powered by KSP. Additional links cover layout selection, state hoisting, loading states, UI testing, and more.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #306
recent_posts.summary: Issue #306 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers new Jetpack Compose releases including the 1.10.5 patch, the first 1.11.0-beta01 (with pointer input changes, FlexBox DSL updates, media query API, and more), and Compose Multiplatform 1.11.0-alpha04. Featured topics include recomposition testing with the DejaVu library, recomposition budgets via the Rebound tool (Kotlin + Android Studio plugin), Compose @Preview internals, and accessibility-aware time-based UI actions. The resource roundup highlights a macOS 26 design system for CMP, a WYSIWYG Markdown editor composable, a TikTok-style video scroll library, and numerous community libraries. Also included is a new section on agent skills for coding assistants targeting Compose development.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #305
recent_posts.summary: Issue #305 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers Compose Multiplatform 1.10.2 patch release, the new FlexBox() container in Compose 1.11 alpha, best practices for LocalContext vs LocalResources for strings, a comprehensive CameraX Compose guide, Android permissions handling with shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale, ContentScale visual guide, ExoPlayer clipping fix using TextureView, and Compose Multiplatform project structure tips. Also featured are new libraries: Dejavu for recomposition assertion testing, Kompass navigation library, NfcReaderKMP for NFC reading, and PulseMVI for MVI on Compose Desktop.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #304
recent_posts.summary: Issue #304 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers the latest Jetpack Compose ecosystem updates. Production artifacts are at 1.10.4 with bug fixes, while 1.11.0-alpha06 formally announces the experimental styles API. Compose Material3 1.5.0-alpha15 adds a scrim component and reworks MaterialTheme to use a single composition local. Nav3 1.1.0-alpha05 replaces the SceneStrategy then() infix with a NavDisplay taking a List<SceneStrategy>. Compose Multiplatform 1.11.0-alpha03 is out with a breaking transitive dependency change. Featured articles cover the upcoming Compose Styles API, Nav2-to-Nav3 migration, Compose SlotTable internals (linked list rewrite), and recomposition stability. Notable new libraries include a Storybook-style scene browser (composium), a LaTeX renderer for CMP, animation modifiers (Springy), and a collapsing top bar scaffold. Coil 3.4.0 and Maps for Compose 8.2.0 also shipped.

recent_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #303
recent_posts.summary: Issue #303 of the jetc.dev newsletter covers Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform topics including reducing development friction, creating custom line graphs with the JetCo library, and replacing ViewModel with the new `retain` APIs. Resource highlights include an IDE plugin for Compose Multiplatform resource helpers, a TextMate-compatible syntax highlighter composable, a form composable with view/edit modes, and a node/link diagram library. Notable release: Circuit 0.33.1 with lifecycle hook overrides and nav stack snapshot initialization.

top_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #236
top_posts.summary: This issue covers Compose Multiplatform UI testing, passing data between screens in Navigation for Compose, creating cross-platform camera apps, and pull-to-refresh implementation in Compose Material3. It also highlights new alpha and beta versions of Compose BOMs, and presents several articles on customizing and optimizing Jetpack Compose UI elements.

top_posts.title: jetc.dev Newsletter Issue #238
top_posts.summary: This issue explores how to determine when a screen is destroyed in a Compose-based UI, the implications of the @Stable annotation in Kotlin, and various tips for using Jetpack Compose effectively. It highlights several Compose-related talks from droidcon Lisbon 2024 and provides resources on tools like Relay and Paparazzi for improving your composable UI development. Also featured are notable repositories and libraries related to Compose, along with recent releases and updates in the ecosystem.
